answer_1.quote: We propose the task of text fact transfer, which aims to alter factual content while preserving style.
answer_1.outputs: Target texts that preserve the style of the source text while transferring factual content to a new topic.

answer_2.quote: We measure the output similarity of the predicted and target texts with ROUGE-1/2 (R1/R2) and BLEU, serving as proxies for style preservation of the source text.

answer_4.quote: We invite two computer science and engineering students to evaluate 50 generated outputs from U.S. News and Google on style (i.e. which output best matches the source text style) and factuality (i.e. which output is more factual).
answer_4.guideline: Following best practices, we use a pairwise comparative evaluation.
